series: SECO registered unemployment rate - seasonally adjusted, contemporaneous monthly vintage
official_source: SECO - Die Lage auf dem Arbeitsmarkt monthly archived releases

evidence.current_archive: GitHub Actions can access and parse recent SECO releases; latest attempt produced 17 valid rows before the coverage gate.
evidence.legacy_archive: 2019-2024 official release PDFs/pages are publicly indexed and browser-accessible, but direct historical downloads fail from the GitHub Actions runner used by this project.
evidence.revision_reason: SECO explicitly states that seasonal adjustment is recomputed when each new observation is added, so the current historical SA series cannot substitute for contemporaneous vintages without revision look-ahead.

blocker: Materialize a reproducible 2021+ SECO seasonally-adjusted unemployment vintage series from contemporaneous releases without using the current recomputed history.
forbidden_workarounds: vendor history used as first-release substitute
raw sight-deposit changes used as intervention proxy
dropping labour after inspecting CHF FX outcomes
